name: Swimming, Breaststroke
instructions: Begin face down in the water with arms extended in front of you. Sweep both arms out and back in a circular motion while simultaneously drawing your knees up toward your chest.
Snap your legs out and together in a whip-like kick as your arms glide forward again, then breathe as your head rises above the water during the arm pull. Glide briefly before repeating the cycle.
Breaststroke is a slower but less exhausting stroke than freestyle. A 150 lb person will burn about 350 calories swimming breaststroke at a moderate pace for 30 minutes.
